INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_SELECT_SRC
(
                CIF_ID,
                ROLE,
                CIF_TYPE,
                SALE_CUST_TMDATE,
                SALESID,
                BANK_ID,
                ACCBRANCHCODE,
                ACCOUNTNUMBER,
                PRODCATID,
                PRODUCTID,
                PRODUCTTYPE,
                PRODUCTSKEY,
                APPLCURRENCY,
                APPLCREATIONDATE,
                ACCESSOWNERBC,
                ACCESSOWNERAGENT,
                SALES_TMDATE,
                AMOUNT1,
                AMOUNT2,
                ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTSTATUS,
                ACCSHORTNAME,
                SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,
                GAM_ACID,
                LAST6_ACCT_NUM,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.CIF_ID,
                CC.ROLE,
                CC.CIF_TYPE,
                CC.SALE_CUST_TMDATE,
                CC.SALESID,
                CC.BANK_ID,
                CC.ACCBRANCHCODE,
                CC.ACCOUNTNUMBER,
                CC.PRODCATID,
                CC.PRODUCTID,
                CC.PRODUCTTYPE,
                CC.PRODUCTSKEY,
                CC.APPLCURRENCY,
                CC.APPLCREATIONDATE,
                CC.ACCESSOWNERBC,
                CC.ACCESSOWNERAGENT,
                CC.SALES_TMDATE,
                CC.AMOUNT1,
                CC.AMOUNT2,
                CC.ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,
                CC.ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,
                CC.ACCOUNTSTATUS,
                CC.ACCSHORTNAME,
                CC.SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,
                CC.GAM_ACID,
                CC.LAST6_ACCT_NUM,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.CRM_CUSTOMER CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER] B ON 
            CC.CIF_ID = B.CIF_ID
            AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
            AND CC.ACCOUNTNUMBER = B.ACCOUNTNUMBER
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_GROUP_SRC
(
                CIF_ID,
                ROLE,
                CIF_TYPE,
                SALE_CUST_TMDATE,
                SALESID,
                BANK_ID,
                ACCBRANCHCODE,
                ACCOUNTNUMBER,
                PRODCATID,
                PRODUCTID,

                PRODUCTSKEY,
                APPLCURRENCY,
                APPLCREATIONDATE,

                SALES_TMDATE,
                AMOUNT1,
                AMOUNT2,
                ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTSTATUS,
                ACCSHORTNAME,
                SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,
                GAM_ACID,
                LAST6_ACCT_NUM,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                CIF_ID,
                ROLE,
                CIF_TYPE,
                SALE_CUST_TMDATE,
                SALESID,
                BANK_ID,
                ACCBRANCHCODE,
                ACCOUNTNUMBER,
                PRODCATID,
                PRODUCTID,
                PRODUCTTYPE,
                PRODUCTSKEY,
                APPLCURRENCY,
                APPLCREATIONDATE,
                ACCESSOWNERBC,
                ACCESSOWNERAGENT,
                SALES_TMDATE,
                AMOUNT1,
                AMOUNT2,
                ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTSTATUS,
                ACCSHORTNAME,
                SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,
                GAM_ACID,
                LAST6_ACCT_NUM,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                CIF_ID,
                ROLE,
                CIF_TYPE,
                SALE_CUST_TMDATE,
                SALESID,
                BANK_ID,
                ACCBRANCHCODE,
                ACCOUNTNUMBER,
                PRODCATID,
                PRODUCTID,
                PRODUCTTYPE,
                PRODUCTSKEY,
                APPLCURRENCY,
                APPLCREATIONDATE,
                ACCESSOWNERBC,
                ACCESSOWNERAGENT,
                SALES_TMDATE,
                AMOUNT1,
                AMOUNT2,
                ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTSTATUS,
                ACCSHORTNAME,
                SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,
                GAM_ACID,
                LAST6_ACCT_NUM,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                CIF_ID,
                ROLE,
                CIF_TYPE,
                SALE_CUST_TMDATE,
                SALESID,
                BANK_ID,
                ACCBRANCHCODE,
                ACCOUNTNUMBER,
                PRODCATID,
                PRODUCTID,
                PRODUCTTYPE,
                PRODUCTSKEY,
                APPLCURRENCY,
                APPLCREATIONDATE,
                ACCESSOWNERBC,
                ACCESSOWNERAGENT,
                SALES_TMDATE,
                AMOUNT1,
                AMOUNT2,
                ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,
                ACCOUNTSTATUS,
                ACCSHORTNAME,
                SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,
                GAM_ACID,
                LAST6_ACCT_NUM
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = dateadd(dd,-1,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE))  FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER];


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.CRM_CUSTOMER A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.CIF_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CIF_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.ACCOUNTNUMBER,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACCOUNTNUMBER,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

SELECT
                SRC.CIF_ID,
                SRC.ROLE,
                SRC.CIF_TYPE,
                SRC.SALE_CUST_TMDATE,
                SRC.SALESID,
                SRC.BANK_ID,
                SRC.ACCBRANCHCODE,
                SRC.ACCOUNTNUMBER,
                SRC.PRODCATID,
                SRC.PRODUCTID,
                SRC.PRODUCTTYPE,
                SRC.PRODUCTSKEY,
                SRC.APPLCURRENCY,
                SRC.APPLCREATIONDATE,
                SRC.ACCESSOWNERBC,
                SRC.ACCESSOWNERAGENT,
                SRC.SALES_TMDATE,
                SRC.AMOUNT1,
                SRC.AMOUNT2,
                SRC.ACCOUNTOPENINGDATE,
                SRC.ACCOUNTCLOSINGDATE,
                SRC.ACCOUNTSTATUS,
                SRC.ACCSHORTNAME,
                SRC.SALE_BACKEND_TMDATE,
                SRC.GAM_ACID,
                SRC.LAST6_ACCT_NUM,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'CRM',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CUSTOMER_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
